labels.B: private 4dd03c optimized daemon, same release command
labels.c19: verified historical daemon retained only for provenance

order_generator: Python random.Random(integer seed). Shuffle [XY,XY,YX,YX], then shuffle each four-block [AB,BA,sham].
trial_unit: Fresh cluster per arm. Preserve signed greeting harness defaults for 4 routes and 3 rotated 24-output image batches per each of 3 routes, summarized within arm by median. All arms use the same archived 296b CLI for setup. Each randomized block has both A/B orders and an identical-daemon sham.
report: All paired ratios, median/range, count in direction, medians by ordering and eight-pair percentile bootstrap intervals (20,000 cluster pair samples; descriptive). Report four independently interleaved A/A ratios as noise reference, fixed previous engineering bounds 1.05 maximum p95 ratio and 0.95 minimum throughput ratio as context. No formal proof of noninferiority; other five routes descriptive.
attempts: One series of 24 arms; stop after 480 seconds or first correctness failure; no reruns.
host_activity: Estimate per-second process CPU plus cgroup usage/throttling. Check exported source stamps, driver, ELF and oracle digests before and after. Wait for coordination clearance before launching.
